papers.title: Benchmarking the Spectrum of Agent Capabilities
papers.description_en: Introduces Crafter, a survival-game environment that evaluates exploration, resource use and long-term behavior through in-game achievements.
papers.description_zh: 提出生存游戏环境 Crafter，通过游戏成就评估探索、资源使用和长期决策能力。

papers.title: TextWorld: A Learning Environment for Text-based Games
papers.description_en: Introduces a controllable text-game generator and learning environment for studying reinforcement learning, generalization and transfer across adventures.
papers.description_zh: 提出可控制的文字游戏生成器和学习环境，用于研究强化学习及其在不同冒险任务间的泛化与迁移。

papers.title: MiniHack the Planet: A Sandbox for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning Research
papers.description_en: Presents a NetHack-based sandbox for creating reinforcement-learning tasks with configurable layouts, objects, dynamics and procedural variation.
papers.description_zh: 提出基于 NetHack 的沙盒，通过可配置的地图、物品、环境动态和程序化变化构建强化学习任务。

papers.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces realistic, self-hosted web environments and executable checks for evaluating agents on multi-step website tasks.
papers.description_zh: 提出可自行部署的真实风格网页环境，并通过可执行检查评估 Agent 的多步骤网站任务完成情况。

papers.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
papers.description_en: Introduces web tasks that require agents to combine visual and textual information, with execution-based evaluation of task completion.
papers.description_zh: 提出需要结合视觉和文字信息的网页任务，并根据实际执行结果评估任务是否完成。

papers.title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
papers.description_en: Studies browser agents on ServiceNow knowledge-work tasks and introduces an environment interface for observing and acting within those workflows.
papers.description_zh: 研究浏览器 Agent 在 ServiceNow 办公任务中的表现，并提出支持观察与动作的交互环境接口。

papers.title: The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research
papers.description_en: Presents a shared browser-agent interface and experiment tooling for comparing behavior across multiple web benchmarks.
papers.description_zh: 提出统一的浏览器 Agent 接口和实验工具，用于比较 Agent 在多个网页基准中的行为。

papers.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
papers.description_en: Introduces a real-computer environment and desktop-task benchmark with configurable initial states and checks of the resulting application and file state.
papers.description_zh: 提出真实电脑交互环境和桌面任务基准，通过配置初始状态并检查应用与文件的结果状态进行评估。

papers.title: AndroidWorld: A Dynamic Benchmarking Environment for Autonomous Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces an Android emulator benchmark with parameterized mobile workflows and rewards derived from system state.
papers.description_zh: 提出 Android 模拟器基准，使用参数化移动应用流程和从系统状态计算的奖励进行评估。

papers.title: Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
papers.description_en: Adapts desktop-agent evaluation to Windows applications and describes parallel execution for scaling repeatable computer-use experiments.
papers.description_zh: 将桌面 Agent 评测扩展到 Windows 应用，并通过并行运行支持可重复的电脑操作实验。

papers.title: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces a native iOS simulator benchmark with connected fictional user data for evaluating cross-app tasks and reasoning over personal context.
papers.description_zh: 提出使用关联虚构用户数据的原生 iOS 模拟器基准，评估跨应用任务和对个人背景信息的推理。

papers.title: MacArena: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on an Online macOS Environment
papers.description_en: Introduces an Apple Silicon macOS evaluation environment combining adapted desktop tasks with workflows specific to macOS.
papers.description_zh: 提出基于 Apple Silicon 的 macOS 评测环境，将移植的桌面任务与 macOS 特有操作流程结合。

papers.title: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces a simulated shopping environment for learning how to interpret product requests and complete searches, selections and purchases through web interactions.
papers.description_zh: 提出模拟购物环境，用于学习如何理解商品需求，并通过网页交互完成搜索、选择和购买流程。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
papers.description_en: Proposes using workflows extracted from demonstrations to guide reinforcement-learning exploration on web interfaces and evaluates the method on browser tasks.
papers.description_zh: 提出从演示中提取工作流程来引导网页界面中的强化学习探索，并在浏览器任务上进行评估。

papers.title: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
papers.description_en: Introduces a diverse dataset of real-website tasks and human action sequences for developing web agents that generalize to unfamiliar sites and domains.
papers.description_zh: 提出覆盖真实网站任务和人工操作序列的数据集，用于研究能够泛化到陌生站点与领域的网页 Agent。

papers.title: An Illusion of Progress? Assessing the Current State of Web Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces Online-Mind2Web and an automated task judge to examine how well web-agent evaluations reflect performance on realistic live websites.
papers.description_zh: 提出 Online-Mind2Web 和自动任务评审方法，研究网页 Agent 评测能否反映其在真实在线网站上的表现。

papers.title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
papers.description_en: Presents a multimodal browser agent, a real-website task benchmark and a model-assisted protocol for assessing task completion.
papers.description_zh: 提出多模态浏览器 Agent、真实网站任务基准，以及辅助判断任务完成情况的模型评审流程。

papers.title: VisualWebBench: How Far Have Multimodal LLMs Evolved in Web Page Understanding and Grounding?
papers.description_en: Introduces a screenshot-based benchmark that separates webpage understanding, text recognition and interface grounding into distinct evaluation tasks.
papers.description_zh: 提出基于截图的网页基准，将页面理解、文字识别和界面定位划分为独立评测任务。

papers.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces a benchmark spanning eight interactive environments to study language-model agents' reasoning, decisions and failure patterns.
papers.description_zh: 提出覆盖八种交互环境的基准，用于研究语言模型 Agent 的推理、决策及失败模式。

papers.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
papers.description_en: Introduces software-repair tasks derived from real GitHub issues, requiring models to modify existing repositories and satisfy project tests.
papers.description_zh: 提出取自真实 GitHub 问题的软件修复任务，要求模型修改现有仓库并通过项目测试。

papers.title: Design2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Code Generation for Automated Front-End Engineering
papers.description_en: Introduces a real-webpage benchmark with visual metrics and human evaluation for measuring how well multimodal models reconstruct interfaces from screenshots.
papers.description_zh: 提出真实网页基准，结合视觉指标与人工评估，衡量多模态模型根据截图重建界面的能力。

papers.title: WebCode2M: A Real-World Dataset for Code Generation from Webpage Designs
papers.description_en: Introduces a large dataset of webpage designs paired with code and layout information, together with a code-generation baseline and structural evaluation metric.
papers.description_zh: 提出将网页设计与代码、布局信息配对的大规模数据集，并提供代码生成基线和结构评测指标。

papers.title: SeeClick: Harnessing GUI Grounding for Advanced Visual GUI Agents
papers.description_en: Presents the SeeClick visual GUI agent and the ScreenSpot benchmark to investigate how locating instructed screen elements supports interface automation.
papers.description_zh: 提出 SeeClick 视觉 GUI Agent 与 ScreenSpot 基准，研究按指令定位屏幕元素如何支持界面自动化。

papers.title: ScreenSpot-Pro: GUI Grounding for Professional High-Resolution Computer Use
papers.description_en: Introduces a professional-software GUI grounding benchmark and a guided visual-search method for finding small targets in high-resolution screenshots.
papers.description_zh: 提出专业软件 GUI 定位基准及引导式视觉搜索方法，用于在高分辨率截图中寻找小型目标。

papers.title: AndroidEnv: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Android
papers.description_en: Presents a reinforcement-learning platform that exposes Android applications through a common touchscreen interface and evaluates agents on configurable tasks.
papers.description_zh: 提出通过统一触屏接口连接 Android 应用的强化学习平台，并在可配置任务上评估 Agent。

papers.title: Android in the Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset for Android Device Control
papers.description_en: Introduces a dataset of human Android interactions with instructions, screens and actions for studying device control across tasks, apps and device configurations.
papers.description_zh: 提出包含指令、画面和动作的人工 Android 交互数据集，用于研究跨任务、应用和设备配置的控制能力。

papers.title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces an Android-agent environment, reproducible task benchmark and instruction dataset for training and comparing text and multimodal agents.
papers.description_zh: 提出 Android Agent 环境、可复现任务基准和指令数据集，用于训练与比较文本及多模态 Agent。

papers.title: AppWorld: A Controllable World of Apps and People for Benchmarking Interactive Coding Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces a controllable world of API-driven apps and a task benchmark that checks interactive coding agents through changes in application state.
papers.description_zh: 提出由 API 驱动的可控应用世界及任务基准，通过应用状态变化评估交互式编程 Agent。

papers.title: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.description_en: Introduces a conversational web-navigation dataset and benchmark, and studies methods for selecting relevant webpage elements during multi-turn interaction.
papers.description_zh: 提出对话式网页导航数据集与基准，并研究在多轮交互中筛选相关网页元素的方法。

papers.title: WorkBench: a Benchmark Dataset for Agents in a Realistic Workplace Setting
papers.description_en: Introduces a sandbox of workplace tools and databases where agents' task outcomes are evaluated by the resulting database changes.
papers.description_zh: 提出由办公工具和数据库组成的沙盒，通过数据库的结果变化评估 Agent 的任务完成情况。

papers.title: Refusal-Trained LLMs Are Easily Jailbroken As Browser Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces BrowserART to study whether language-model safety refusals carry over from chat interactions to browser-agent actions.
papers.description_zh: 提出 BrowserART，用于研究语言模型在聊天中的安全拒绝行为能否延续到浏览器 Agent 的操作中。

papers.title: Spider2-V: How Far Are Multimodal Agents From Automating Data Science and Engineering Workflows?
papers.description_en: Introduces a computer-use benchmark for data-science and engineering workflows that require coordinated code generation and GUI operations in professional tools.
papers.description_zh: 提出面向数据科学与工程流程的电脑操作基准，要求在专业工具中结合代码生成和 GUI 操作。

papers.title: The NetHack Learning Environment
papers.description_en: Introduces a NetHack-based learning environment for studying exploration, planning and skill acquisition in fast, procedurally generated game worlds.
papers.description_zh: 提出基于 NetHack 的学习环境，在运行高效、程序化生成的游戏世界中研究探索、规划和技能习得。

papers.title: MineDojo: Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents with Internet-Scale Knowledge
papers.description_en: Introduces a Minecraft task suite and multimodal knowledge collection, alongside an agent-learning method that uses video-language models to provide rewards.
papers.description_zh: 提出 Minecraft 任务套件和多模态知识资料库，并研究利用视频语言模型提供奖励的 Agent 学习方法。

papers.title: MineRL: A Large-Scale Dataset of Minecraft Demonstrations
papers.description_en: Introduces a simulator-paired dataset of human Minecraft demonstrations for studying learning methods that use examples to reduce interaction requirements.
papers.description_zh: 提出与模拟器配套的人工 Minecraft 演示数据集，用于研究通过示范减少交互需求的学习方法。

papers.title: BALROG: Benchmarking Agentic LLM and VLM Reasoning On Games
papers.description_en: Introduces a benchmark that connects language and vision-language agents to existing games of varied complexity to assess sequential decision-making.
papers.description_zh: 提出连接现有不同复杂度游戏的基准，用于评估语言与视觉语言 Agent 的连续决策能力。

papers.title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games
papers.description_en: Presents a common framework of game environments, algorithms and analysis tools for reinforcement learning, game theory and search.
papers.description_zh: 介绍整合游戏环境、算法和分析工具的统一框架，支持强化学习、博弈论和搜索研究。

papers.title: Leveraging Procedural Generation to Benchmark Reinforcement Learning
papers.description_en: Introduces procedurally generated game environments and experimental protocols for measuring reinforcement-learning sample efficiency and generalization.
papers.description_zh: 提出程序化生成的游戏环境及实验规范，用于衡量强化学习的样本效率和泛化能力。

papers.title: ScienceWorld: Is your Agent Smarter than a 5th Grader?
papers.description_en: Introduces an interactive text world for evaluating whether agents can apply elementary science concepts through experiments and object manipulation.
papers.description_zh: 提出交互式文字世界，通过实验和物体操作评估 Agent 能否运用基础科学概念。

papers.title: VirtualHome: Simulating Household Activities via Programs
papers.description_en: Represents household activities as executable action programs and introduces a simulator for grounding those programs in visual household scenes.
papers.description_zh: 将家庭活动表示为可执行的动作程序，并提出在可视化家庭场景中运行这些程序的模拟器。

papers.title: Minigrid & Miniworld: Modular & Customizable Reinforcement Learning Environments for Goal-Oriented Tasks
papers.description_en: Presents the design and shared interfaces of Minigrid and Miniworld for creating configurable two- and three-dimensional goal-directed learning tasks.
papers.description_zh: 介绍 Minigrid 与 Miniworld 的设计和统一接口，用于构建可配置的二维、三维目标导向学习任务。

papers.title: Interactive Fiction Games: A Colossal Adventure
papers.description_en: Introduces Jericho as an interface to existing interactive-fiction games and examines the challenges they pose for language-based agents.
papers.description_zh: 提出连接现有交互式文字游戏的 Jericho 接口，并分析这些游戏对语言 Agent 带来的挑战。

papers.title: The Arcade Learning Environment: An Evaluation Platform for General Agents
papers.description_en: Introduces an Atari-game interface and evaluation methodology for comparing general-purpose learning and planning agents across games.
papers.description_zh: 提出 Atari 游戏交互接口及评测方法，用于比较通用学习与规划 Agent 在不同游戏中的表现。
papers.date_note: published_at is the first arXiv submission date; journal_published_at is the JAIR publication date.
